# Loyalties — Digital Stamp Card Platform for Local Businesses

Site: https://loyalties.marketing

This file lists resource articles for LLM indexing. Loyalties is a wallet-based stamp card for local businesses. Customers add a branded card to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet. There is no app to download.
